axes.note: figure axes are (detection, excitation); our convention is (omega_tau, omega_t) = (excitation, detection)

map_type: INTENSITY (magnitude) map, all values positive. Colour scale runs white (zero) -> tan -> red -> dark blue, with DARKER meaning LARGER intensity, so the blue blobs are the strongest features. Directly comparable with our |FFT| censuses.
digitisation_method: visual, from the supplied raster; positions +-0.05 THz; amplitudes normalised to the strongest feature (blue = 1.0, red ~ 0.3-0.45, tan ~ 0.15)

all_features.note: faint tail of the qFM row

structural_observations: Strongest features are on the qFM excitation rows (+-0.38 THz) at detection 0.05 and 0.62; there is NO strong feature on an excitation row at 0.50 (E12).
The qFM excitation row carries a whole progression in detection: 0.05, 0.30, 0.62, 0.90, (1.15 faint).
A pump-probe row at zero excitation carries features at detection 0.50 and 0.78.
The two + markers lie on the qAFM excitation row (0.90) at detection 0.50 and 1.25, i.e. (qAFM,E12) and (qAFM,E13) in our convention, at about 0.3 of the strongest feature.
Detection extends to 2 THz with nothing beyond ~1.3 THz.
The map is roughly symmetric under excitation -> -excitation for the qFM family (0.05 and 0.30 appear on both signs), but the qAFM markers appear only at +0.90.

discrepancy_flag.issue: This differs from the same-polarised list used to build the current model, (omega_tau, omega_t) = (0.5,0), (0.5,0.7), (0.5,1.2), (0.9,0.38), (0.9,1.2) with the 0.5-excitation family strongest.
discrepancy_flag.as_read_here: the dominant family is at excitation 0.38 (qFM), and the marked family is at excitation 0.90 (qAFM); no strong 0.50-excitation family
discrepancy_flag.possible_resolution: if the earlier list was ordered (detection, excitation) rather than (excitation, detection), then (0.5,0)->det 0.5/exc 0 MATCHES the observed pump-probe feature, and (0.9,0.38)->det 0.9/exc 0.38 MATCHES the observed qFM-row feature; needs confirmation
